# ChatGPT 4o系统提示词泄露的SEO影响分析

- 作者：Flavio Amiel（@fba）
- 原帖发布时间：2025-07-07 14:07（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/fba/status/1942103047376642088
- 收藏日期：2026-10-29

## 中文全文

1. @aleyda 分享了 @HannsKronenberg 的分析，依据是 @jlalmes 泄露的 ChatGPT 4o 内部系统提示词：
https://x.com/aleyda/status/1939931042149810575

### 原帖中的引用预览（非被引用文章全文）

[Aleyda Solis 🕊️ @aleyda](<https://x.com/aleyda/status/1939931042149810575>)

ChatGPT 4o 系统提示词泄露：对 SEO 的影响 👀 @HannsKronenberg 基于 @jlalmes 泄露内容所做的分析 👇

* 系统提示词严格限定了 ChatGPT 4o 可以使用网页工具的条件，例如实时或当前信息、特定位置的信息，或模型训练数据未覆盖的难以查找的小众主题。

* 网页搜索如何运作：ChatGPT 每次请求最多可以生成五个不同的搜索查询；相关词项会用 + 标记，以提高搜索结果的针对性；–QDF 参数调节新近结果的优先程度；如果用户的查询不是英语，ChatGPT 会同时用英语和原始语言发起搜索查询。

* 回答中的链接，只有通过实时搜索发现后才会出现。而鉴于搜索被激活的频率非常低，这意味着：ChatGPT 回答中出现链接是例外，而非常态。

* 系统提示词没有任何迹象表明 ChatGPT 会存储 URL，或维护持久化的网页索引：它不存在与 Google 等搜索引擎类似的网页抓取或存储机制。

* 当实时搜索被触发时，网站可以通过实时搜索结果出现在 ChatGPT 的回答中。不过，考虑到搜索极少被激活，而且它不持续存储 URL，这种可见度仍然属于例外情况。

* 对 SEO 和内容可见度而言，结论很明确：如果在 ChatGPT 触发搜索的那一刻，你的网站没有在 Bing 的实时搜索摘要中获得显著排名，就不太可能被引用或产生点击。

必读：https://gpt-insights.de/ai-insights/chatgpt-leak-web-search-en/

## 英文原文

1. @aleyda shared the analysis by @HannsKronenberg based on @jlalmes leak on ChatGPT 4o internal system prompt:
https://x.com/aleyda/status/1939931042149810575

### Quoted preview

[Aleyda Solis 🕊️ @aleyda](<https://x.com/aleyda/status/1939931042149810575>)

ChatGPT 4o System Prompt Leak: SEO Impact 👀 Analysis by @HannsKronenberg  based on @jlalmes  leak 👇

* The system prompt defines strict, narrow conditions under which ChatGPT 4o is allowed to use the web tool, like Real-time or current information, Location-specific information or Hard-to-find, niche topics not covered in the model’s training data.

* How Web search works: ChatGPT can generate up to five distinct search queries per request, Relevant terms are marked with + to improve search result targeting, The –QDF parameter adjusts how strongly fresh results are prioritized, If the user’s query is not in English, ChatGPT sends search queries in both English and the original language.

* Links in responses only appear if surfaced through live search and given how rarely search is activated, this means: Links in ChatGPT answers are the exception, not the rule.

* The system prompt contains no indication that ChatGPT stores URLs or maintains a persistent web index: There is no crawling or storage of web pages comparable to search engines like Google.

* Website visibility in ChatGPT answers can occur via real-time search results when live search is triggered. However, given how rarely search is activated and the lack of persistent URL storage, this form of visibility remains the exception.

* For SEO and content visibility, the implication is clear: If your website isn’t ranked prominently in Bing real-time search snippets at the moment ChatGPT triggers search, you are unlikely to be cited or generate clicks.
